title: Cycling rules in Poland
question: What are the main rules for cyclists in Poland?
short_answer: Cyclists must use bike lanes where available, obey traffic rules, and have lights at night.
conditions: Must use designated cycle paths (droga dla rowerów) where available
May ride on the road if no cycle path exists
Lights are mandatory from dusk to dawn (front white, rear red)
May ride on pavements only if a sign permits it or with a child under 10
Cyclists under 18 must wear a helmet
exceptions: Adults are not required by law to wear helmets (but it is recommended)
Children under 10 may ride on pavements under adult supervision
penalties: Fine: 50–300 PLN for cycling on pavement without permission
Fine: 50–300 PLN for riding without lights at night
Fine: 200–500 PLN for cycling under the influence of alcohol
